description: Defines the OCIContainer class which implements a plugin for JSONRPC communication handling container management operations such as list, start, stop, pause, resume, and execute commands, along with container event notifications.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: A plugin class for managing OCI containers via JSONRPC, supporting container lifecycle operations and event notifications.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Lists all containers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby specification.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Event handler called when a container starts.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Event handler called when a container stops.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the API version number of the plugin.
